expected.title: A quantitative parabolic shearing criterion for disjointness of weakly mixing flows on sigma-compact metric probability spaces

expected.difficulty_reason: A non-product ergodic joining is separated by a nonzero time displacement. Measurable selection and Lusin uniform continuity lift a positive-measure family of near-identity sheared pairs into the joining; uniform ergodic averages and compact control of the common time lag force contradictory invariance estimates.
